The '''Workers''' was the worker caste of the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Workers appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
